label: Canadian Market Basket budget
field.name: Name
help.budget: A modest basic standard based on Statistics Canada’s 2025 Market Basket Measure. Enter shelter separately and deselect any costs you already budget for. Change the preset if your region or family size changes.

invalid.household: Enter a whole family size from 1 to 20.
invalid.name: Enter a name of 1 to 80 characters.
